actions: Locate oak trees in the current area where you are playing Minecraft.
Approach the nearest oak tree.
Position yourself close to the oak tree so that you can reach the trunk.
Break the oak log block using your hand.
Collect the dropped oak log until you have 1 in your inventory.
Repeat the process of breaking the oak log and collecting it until you have 7 oak logs in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 oak logs.
Open your crafting interface to access the crafting grid.
Place 1 oak_log in any slot of the crafting grid.
Observe the output section of the crafting interface to see the resulting oak_planks.
Craft the oak_planks to obtain 4 oak_planks.
Repeat the previous three steps two more times to use 2 additional oak_logs.
After crafting for the second time, you will have 8 oak_planks in total.
Use 1 more oak_log in the crafting grid again to craft another 4 oak_planks.
After this final crafting step, you will have a total of 12 oak_planks in your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the items you currently have.
Confirm that you have 4 oak_planks in your inventory.
Navigate to your crafting interface or crafting table.
Select the crafting option to begin creating a new item.
Place 4 oak_planks in the crafting grid.
Ensure that the crafting recipe for a crafting_table is displayed in the output section.
Take the crafting_table from the output section and add it to your inventory.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 2 oak planks into the crafting grid.
Craft sticks using the oak planks in the crafting table.
Collect the 4 sticks that are produced from the crafting process.
Verify that your inventory now contains 4 sticks.
Repeat steps 1 to 5 two more times to craft additional sticks.
After the second crafting, verify that your inventory contains 8 sticks.
Repeat the crafting process one more time to obtain the final stick.
Confirm that your inventory contains a total of 9 sticks.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 3 oak planks into the crafting grid.
Place 2 sticks into the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting grid shows the recipe for a wooden pickaxe.
Craft 1 wooden pickaxe.
Collect the wooden pickaxe from the crafting table.
Check your inventory to confirm that you now have 1 wooden pickaxe.
Equip the wooden_pickaxe from your inventory.
Find a location with stone blocks, which are typically found underground or on cliffs.
Approach a stone block in your vicinity.
Strike the stone block with the wooden_pickaxe to break it.
Collect the cobblestone that drops from the broken stone block.
Repeat the process of striking stone blocks and collecting cobblestone until you have a total of 11 cobblestone in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 11 cobblestone.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Verify that you have 3 cobblestones in your inventory.
Verify that you have 2 sticks in your inventory.
Approach the crafting table in your current location.
Open the crafting interface of the crafting table.
Place 3 cobblestones in the bottom row of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the middle square of the left column of the crafting grid.
Confirm the placement of the items in the crafting grid.
Observe that a stone pickaxe appears as the result in the crafting interface.
Drag the stone pickaxe from the crafting interface into your inventory.
Equip the wooden pickaxe from your inventory.
Locate a coal ore block in the nearby area.
Approach the coal ore block.
Mine the coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Collect the dropped coal item from the mined coal ore.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 two more times to obtain a total of 3 coal.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 3 coal.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Confirm that you have 8 cobblestone in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table you have in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, arrange 8 cobblestone in all the outer slots.
Observe the output slot of the crafting interface to see the furnace appear.
Drag the furnace from the output slot into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface after successfully crafting the furnace.
Locate a cave or a mountainous area where iron ore is likely to be found.
Equip the stone pickaxe from your inventory.
Approach the iron ore blocks in the cave or mountainous area.
Mine the first iron ore block using the stone pickaxe.
Collect the raw iron that drops from the mined iron ore block.
Repeat the mining action for the second iron ore block.
Collect the raw iron that drops from the second mined iron ore block.
Continue to mine the third iron ore block and collect the raw iron.
Mine the fourth iron ore block and collect the raw iron.
Mine the fifth iron ore block and collect the raw iron.
Mine the sixth iron ore block and collect the raw iron.
Finally, mine the seventh iron ore block and collect the raw iron.
Verify that your inventory contains a total of 7 raw iron.
Open your inventory to confirm you have 7 raw_iron available.
Ensure you have a furnace placed in your vicinity.
Open the furnace interface to prepare for smelting.
Place 1 raw_iron into the top slot of the furnace.
Add 1 piece of coal to the fuel slot of the furnace.
Wait for the smelting process to complete and collect 1 iron_ingot from the furnace.
Repeat steps 4 to 6 six more times until you have a total of 7 iron_ingot in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 7 iron_ingot.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Confirm that you have 3 iron ingots in your inventory.
Confirm that you have 2 sticks in your inventory.
Confirm that you have a crafting table in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Stand next to the crafting table.
Open the crafting interface by right-clicking on the crafting table.
Place 3 iron ingots in the crafting grid, filling the top row.
Place 2 sticks in the crafting grid, one in the middle cell of the second row and one in the middle cell of the third row.
Verify that the crafting grid shows an iron pickaxe as the result.
Drag the iron pickaxe from the crafting result box into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Confirm that you have at least 3 iron ingots in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table that you have in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in a suitable location.
Interact with the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Arrange the 3 iron ingots in a V shape in the crafting grid (two on the bottom row and one in the middle of the top row).
Confirm that the crafting table shows a bucket as the resulting item.
Click on the bucket to craft it and add it to your inventory.
Locate a cave or mountainous area where diamond ore is commonly found.
Equip the iron pickaxe from your inventory.
Begin mining the diamond ore blocks you find in the cave or mountainous area.
Continue mining until you have collected 29 diamond ore blocks.
Once you have mined 29 diamond ore blocks, verify that your inventory contains exactly 29 diamond ore.
If you have not yet reached the required amount, continue searching and mining for diamond ore until you do.
Find a gravel block in your current surroundings.
Use your iron pickaxe to break the gravel block.
Collect the dropped item from the gravel block.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 flint.
Locate a body of water in the current area.
Approach the water source while holding the bucket in your inventory.
Look at the water and ensure that the bucket is selected.
Pour the water from the bucket into the water source.
Verify that you now have 1 water_bucket in your inventory.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 3 diamonds in the top row of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center slot of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center-left slot of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting grid displays a diamond pickaxe as the output.
Drag the diamond pickaxe from the crafting grid to your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Locate the crafting table in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Ensure that you have 1 iron_ingot and 1 flint in your inventory.
Drag the 1 iron_ingot from your inventory into the crafting grid.
Drag the 1 flint from your inventory into the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting grid shows the flint_and_steel recipe.
Click on the flint_and_steel icon to craft it.
Collect the flint_and_steel from the crafting output.
Check your inventory to confirm that you now have 1 flint_and_steel.
Equip the diamond pickaxe from your inventory.
Locate a source of lava, such as a lava pool or a cave with lava.
Ensure that you have the water bucket in your inventory.
Pour water from the water bucket onto the lava to create obsidian blocks.
Use the diamond pickaxe to mine the obsidian block that was just created.
Collect the obsidian block into your inventory.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 until you have mined a total of 10 obsidian blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 10 obsidian blocks.
Verify that you have a crafting_table in your inventory.
Open your crafting_table interface.
Locate the diamond items in your inventory.
Ensure you have 4 diamonds available in your inventory.
Arrange the diamonds in the crafting grid as follows: place 2 diamonds in the left column (one on top of the other), and place 2 diamonds in the right column (one on top of the other).
Confirm that the crafting grid displays diamond_boots as the output.
Drag the diamond_boots from the crafting output to your inventory.
Close the crafting_table interface.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 diamond_boots.
Open your inventory to verify that you have at least 7 diamonds available.
Ensure that you have a crafting table in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Arrange the 7 diamonds in the crafting grid to form the shape of diamond leggings.
Confirm that the crafting interface shows 1 diamond_leggings as the result.
Drag the diamond_leggings into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Close the crafting interface to return to the game.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Ensure that you have at least 8 diamonds in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in a suitable location for crafting.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 8 diamonds in the designated slots to create a diamond chestplate.
Verify that the diamond chestplate is now visible in the result slot of the crafting interface.
Drag the diamond chestplate into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Confirm that you now have 1 diamond chestplate in your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Ensure that you have at least 5 diamonds in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in a suitable location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Arrange 5 diamonds in the crafting grid to create a diamond helmet.
Verify that the diamond helmet appears in the result box of the crafting interface.
Drag the diamond helmet from the result box into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Verify that your inventory contains at least 2 diamonds.
Verify that your inventory contains at least 1 stick.
Verify that your inventory contains a crafting table.
Approach the crafting table located in your vicinity.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place 2 diamonds in the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the crafting grid.
Confirm the crafting recipe for a diamond sword is visible.
Click on the diamond sword icon to craft it.
Collect the diamond sword from the crafting table output.
Verify that your inventory contains 10 obsidian blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains 1 flint_and_steel.
Choose a suitable location to build the nether portal.
Place 4 obsidian blocks in a vertical orientation to create the two sides of the portal.
Place 3 obsidian blocks in a horizontal orientation to form the bottom of the portal.
Place 3 more obsidian blocks in a horizontal orientation at the top to complete the rectangular frame of the portal.
Ensure that the portal frame is at least 4 blocks high and 5 blocks wide.
Use the flint_and_steel from your inventory to ignite the inside of the portal frame.
Confirm that the portal is successfully activated and has a purple swirling interior.
You have now built 1 nether_portal.
Locate the nether portal in your inventory.
Use the flint_and_steel to ignite the nether portal.
Step into the activated nether portal to enter the Nether dimension.
Once in the Nether, navigate through the area to find a fortress.
Look for blazes within the fortress area.
Equip your diamond_sword to prepare for battle.
Approach a blaze and initiate an attack.
Continue attacking the blaze until it is defeated.
Collect the blaze_rod dropped by the defeated blaze.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 blaze_rod.
Open your inventory to confirm that you have at least 1 blaze_rod available.
Approach the crafting_table in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 1 blaze_rod in any slot.
Observe the output of the crafting grid, ensuring that it shows 2 blaze_powder as the result.
Click on the crafted blaze_powder to collect it into your inventory.
Verify that your inventory now contains at least 1 blaze_powder.
Equip the diamond helmet, diamond chestplate, diamond leggings, diamond boots, and diamond sword from your inventory.
Locate an area where endermen commonly spawn, such as a desert or a plains biome.
Search for an enderman in the vicinity.
Once you spot an enderman, approach it carefully to avoid startling it.
Attack the enderman with your diamond sword until it is defeated.
Collect the ender pearl dropped by the defeated enderman.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 1 ender_pearl.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Ensure that you have 1 ender_pearl in your inventory.
Ensure that you have 1 blaze_powder in your inventory.
Locate the crafting_table in your inventory.
Place the crafting_table on the ground in an accessible location.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place the 1 ender_pearl in any slot.
Place the 1 blaze_powder in any other slot of the crafting grid.
Observe the resulting ender_eye appear in the crafting output.
Drag the ender_eye from the crafting output into your inventory.
